content_sections.heading: ICSIL I.T. Assistant Vacancy Details (Post-wise)
content_sections.text: There are a total of 4 vacancies available for the post of I.T. Assistant.

content_sections.heading: ICSIL I.T. Assistant Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must also possess 5 years of experience in any Government Organization / PSU / Deptt.

rows.qualification_required: Graduate and 01 year Diploma in Computer Application

content_sections.heading: ICSIL I.T. Assistant Age Limit
content_sections.text: The maximum age limit is Not more than 37 Years as on the date of walk-in.

content_sections.heading: ICSIL I.T. Assistant Salary
content_sections.text: Fifteen (15) days salary is deducted from the selected candidate as security in two parts (50% in the first month and 50% in the second month), which is refundable with saving bank interest after receiving a No Dues certificate from the client department and completing contractual liabilities.

content_sections.heading: ICSIL I.T. Assistant Application Fee
content_sections.text: The One Time Registration (OTR) fee of Rs. 590/- must be paid online on the ICSIL website before attending the walk-in interview.

content_sections.heading: ICSIL I.T. Assistant Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process includes scrutiny of documents (age, qualification, experience, etc.) as per prescribed criteria, followed by interaction or interview of the candidate with the department. The selection may also include a personal interview/skill test or written test depending on the position.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ICSIL I.T. Assistant
content_sections.text: Go to the official ICSIL website at www.icsil.in. Complete the online registration and make the online One Time Registration (OTR) fee payment of Rs. 590/-. Print out the proof of payment of the OTR fee from your manage profile. Bring the printed payment proof along with 1 set of photocopies of all relevant documents, 2 photographs, and original documents. Report for the walk-in interview at the venue on 15/10/2026 between 10:30 AM and 12:30 PM.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Original documents in respect of Date of Birth (DOB), Qualification, and Experience 1 set of photocopies of all relevant documents 2 recent photographs Proof of payment of One Time Registration fee of Rs. 590/- printed from manage profile Class 10th Certificate, PAN Card, and Aadhar Card (details must match the application form) Evidence for name change if the name was changed subsequent to Class 10th

content_sections.heading: ICSIL I.T. Assistant Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Applicants must make the OTR fee payment before the walk-in interview to avoid late receipt or update issues. Only candidates who have registered online and paid the fee will be entertained for the walk-in interview. No TA/DA will be provided for appearing in the interaction or document verification. The place of deployment will be anywhere in Delhi/NCR, and candidates may work in shifts or on a rotational basis. Candidates must produce original documents on the date of document verification; otherwise, they will not be allowed to appear in the interview. Canvassing in any form will lead to immediate disqualification. Fifteen days salary will be deducted as security, refundable upon completion of contractual liabilities and receipt of a No Dues certificate.

faq.question: Q1. What is ICSIL I.T. Assistant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: ICSIL I.T. Assistant Recruitment 2026 is a contractual recruitment process conducted by Intelligent Communication Systems India Ltd. to deploy 4 I.T. Assistants in Delhi Tourism and Transportation Development Corporation Ltd. (DTTDC).

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for ICSIL I.T. Assistant?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies available for the I.T. Assistant post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the walk-in interview date for ICSIL I.T. Assistant?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 15/10/2026 with a reporting time from 10:30 AM to 12:30 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the venue for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The venue is DTTDC Headquarter, 18-A, DDA, SCO Complex, Defence Colony, New Delhi-110024.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification required for ICSIL I.T. Assistant?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Graduate degree and a 01 year Diploma in Computer Application along with 5 years of experience in any Government Organization, PSU, or Department.

faq.question: Q6. What is the upper age limit for the post?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is not more than 37 years as on the date of the walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee for ICSIL I.T. Assistant?
faq.answer: The One Time Registration (OTR) fee is Rs. 590/-, which is non-refundable and must be paid online on the ICSIL website.

faq.question: Q8. What is the monthly salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a remuneration of Rs. 48,000/- per month plus EPF.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any written examination for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection is based on document scrutiny and interaction or interview with the department, and may include a personal interview, skill test, or written test depending on the position.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: No, the engagement is purely on a contractual/outsourced basis for initially one year or till expiry of contract or regular incumbents join posts, and does not guarantee regular appointment.
